integrity: The count is proved from the defining matrix equations and independently exhaustively enumerated over all 729 symmetric 2x2 matrices over GF(9). All ten associated systematic codes are enumerated exactly, including an explicit MDS witness and its complete weight distribution.
scientific_limitations: The correction is confined to symmetric \(2\times2\) matrices over \(\mathbb F_9\) under the public source definition \(A^{-1}=-A\). It does not assess the higher-dimensional tables or assert a new general counting theorem. The full article PDF was not obtainable during source inspection.
title: The \(q=9\) SIS count is \(10\), with four MDS \([4,2,3]\) constructions
